Prepare your organization for the upcoming Digital Product Passport (DPP) requirements and build the foundation for high-quality product data, efficient processes, and future AI use cases. Our audit evaluates your current DPP readiness, identifies gaps in data, processes, and governance, and provides a prioritized roadmap for the next steps.

With the introduction of the EU Digital Product Passport (DPP), requirements for product transparency, sustainability, and product information are increasing. For many organizations, it is becoming clear that the real challenge is not only regulatory compliance but also the quality and governance of their product data. Incomplete product information, missing sustainability data, fragmented supplier information, and insufficient product data governance not only make DPP compliance more difficult but also limit initiatives such as AI Search, Agentic Commerce, and digital product experiences.
Assessment of your current maturity level, including the early identification of risks and improvement areas.
Identification of missing product attributes, data sources, processes, and governance structures.
Actionable recommendations including quick wins as well as medium- and long-term initiatives.
Use the Digital Product Passport as the starting point for a sustainable Product Data Transformation that goes far beyond compliance.
Independent assessment of your existing systems and technologies, regardless of software vendor.
Build the foundation for AI Search, Agentic Commerce, and automated product data management.

You receive a DPP Readiness Score, an assessment of your Product Data Maturity, a comprehensive gap analysis, an executive summary, and a prioritized roadmap with short- and long-term recommendations.
Analysis of your product data sources, systems (PIM, ERP, DAM), data flows, and organizational processes.
Assessment of data quality, completeness, sustainability information, governance, and process maturity against future DPP requirements.
Identification of data gaps, process weaknesses, governance deficiencies, and technical limitations.
Development of a future-ready data architecture and operating model.
A structured implementation roadmap with quick wins as well as medium- and long-term recommendations for your Product Data Transformation.

The Digital Product Passport is not just a regulatory requirement—it is an opportunity to strengthen your product data and prepare your organization for future digital requirements. Our Digital Product Passport Audit shows you where you stand today and provides clear recommendations and a practical roadmap for the next steps.

The audit evaluates how well your organization is prepared for upcoming Digital Product Passport requirements. It assesses your product data landscape, data quality, governance, processes, and systems. You receive a readiness score, a gap analysis, and actionable recommendations for moving forward.

Although DPP requirements will be introduced gradually, building the necessary product data foundation, governance structures, and processes takes time. Starting early reduces risk and prepares your business for future AI and commerce initiatives.

No. The Digital Product Passport often reveals underlying challenges in product data quality, governance, and processes. Addressing these issues creates long-term business value beyond regulatory compliance.

In many cases, yes. The biggest challenges are typically data quality, governance, process maturity, and integration across systems rather than the technology itself. The audit identifies where improvements are needed.
Depending on your environment, we assess PIM, ERP, DAM, commerce platforms, supplier data sources, and the data flows between these systems.
You receive a clear assessment of your DPP readiness together with a practical action plan covering the organizational, process, and technical capabilities required for the Digital Product Passport.

The audit is intended for organizations with large product assortments, multiple product data sources, supplier-driven product information, and increasing requirements around sustainability, compliance, and product data governance.

The audit starts with an assessment of your current product data landscape. We then evaluate your DPP readiness, identify gaps across data, processes, and governance, and develop a prioritized roadmap for implementation.
Our audit is independent of any software vendor. This allows us to objectively assess your existing landscape and recommend the most appropriate improvements based on your business requirements.

The audit often serves as the starting point for broader initiatives such as Product Data Governance programs, PIM optimization or migration, supplier data integration, product data quality initiatives, AI-powered Product Data Management, and Agentic Commerce enablement.
